name: tmc-level-params
description: Level difficulty parameter harness for level designers: from a theme name, generate one checked parameter set per difficulty tier (five tiers learned from the competitor difficulty labels) plus one shared asset list.

interface.shortDescription: Generate per-tier difficulty parameters for a theme.
interface.longDescription: For level designers, not production. Input a theme name. Five difficulty tiers are learned from the competitor mainline data: a class-balanced logistic model scores how much a level looks like the competitor Hard/ExHard levels from six parameters, and the score quantiles cut the real levels into five equal tiers. For each tier the harness draws the joint form, totals, kinds, four-category split, per-kind counts, targets, stacking, moving vehicles and duration from real levels of that tier, checks every rule and that the drawn parameters score inside the tier, and writes level-params.json/csv/xlsx with one asset list shared by all tiers. Items are placeholders (building 1, prop 3). Standard library only; xlsx export needs xlsxwriter.
defaultPrompt: 给"月球基地"主题生成 5 个难度档位的参数。
画出这个主题的总览图，看 5 组参数在竞品整体难度中的位置。
复查这份 level-params.json 是否还通过全部检查。
